before: A painted field result said only that it was a field (data-field-atom); a host could not style its own kinds of field differently.
after: Field atoms carry their instruction in the layout record, and surface.setFieldTones lets a host name each field from it; the paint publishes the name as data-field-tone. Changing the function repaints without laying anything out.
reason: Paint only: nothing reaches the document, an operation, the journal or an export, so released participants are unaffected.
